title: Vireo Analytics unveils LLM tracing as Meridian deal awaits close
author: Jonah Whitfield
text:
Vireo Analytics has unveiled LLM Trace, a module that records every prompt, model response and token bill flowing through an application, and said it will remain available on all major clouds while its sale to Meridian Cloud is pending.

The module tags each model call with its cost and latency and flags responses that drift from expected formats, a problem that engineering teams say has become harder to spot as applications chain several models together.

"Teams are shipping AI features faster than they can monitor them," said Owen Brandt, Vireo's co-founder. "Trace is meant to make a model call as observable as a database query."

Vireo said more than 300 customers had used the module during a three-month beta. It costs $0.40 per 1,000 traced calls.

The announcement is Vireo's first since agreeing to its $1.2 billion sale last week. Brandt said product plans had not changed and that the module would support models from any provider.
